english.title: Knowingly / recklessly give false / misleading information to an authorised person
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly or recklessly gave false or misleading information namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..) to **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a person authorised under regulation 22 of the Animal By-Products (Enforcement) (England) Regulations 2013

english.notes: In relation to offences committed prior to 12th December 2013, see offence document H18665.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
